title: “Code was never the hard part” is an insult to all programmers
summary: A thought-provoking blog post challenging the common tech industry assertion that 'code is the easy part,' arguing this dismissive attitude undermines programmers' expertise and devalues the craft of software development.
problem_solved: Addresses the dismissive culture in tech that trivializes coding as the simple aspect of software development.
why_valuable: Validates programmers' skills and counters gatekeeping narratives that belittle technical execution, resonating with 735 HN points and 433 comments.
